# Aussie Growth

> Aussie Growth is an Australian digital agency. It builds websites, runs paid ads (Google, Meta, Instagram) and sets up AI and automation (CRM, instant replies, follow-up, booking) for tradies, home-service businesses and local businesses.

Also written as: Aussie Growth Digital Marketing, Aussie Growth Agency, aussiegrowth.agency
Official website: https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/
Phone: +61 493 721 273
Email: meharmalik2026@gmail.com
Country served: Australia
Language: English (Australia)

## What Aussie Growth does

- Web development: custom business websites, redesigns, landing pages, quote forms and booking systems. Mobile-first.
- Paid ads: Google Ads, Meta Ads and Instagram Ads, with tracking, sent to pages built to turn clicks into calls.
- AI and automation: CRM, instant replies, follow-up, booking automation, email and SMS workflows.
- The three services work as one process: Get seen (website), Get booked (ads), Get paid (automation).

## Who Aussie Growth helps

- Tradies and home services: builders, electricians, plumbers, landscapers, roofers, solar, HVAC, renovations.
- Local businesses: clinics, gyms, hospitality, automotive, retail, professional services.

- [AI and automation](https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/ai-automation/): CRM, instant replies, follow-up and booking automation
- [Websites for tradies](https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/tradie-websites/): builders, electricians, plumbers, landscapers, roofers, solar, HVAC, renovations
- [Local business marketing](https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/local-business-marketing/): clinics, gyms, hospitality, automotive, retail, professional services
- [$0 Website offer](https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/free-website/): two Australian businesses get a professional website for $0 every Monday (live in about a month, 3 revisions, a short video testimonial once it is finished). Optional $1,500 fast-track gets it in about a week.

## Common questions

- How do I get a quote? Use the five-question quote form on the home page (about a minute). A real person replies with a recommendation and a quote.
- Is there a long contract? No. Terms are explained before any work starts.
- Does Aussie Growth build the website and run the ads? Yes. One team does both.
- How long does a website take? Most small-business sites take a few weeks. Content (photos, copy, sign-off) is the main variable.

## Notes

- Portfolio projects shown on the site are real websites built by Aussie Growth.
- Photography and the brand film on the site are illustrative, not client footage.
- The site publishes no client testimonials, ratings or performance statistics.
- Aussie Growth does not guarantee sales or leads.


# Full page text


## Digital Agency in Australia | Websites, Ads & AI | Aussie Growth
URL: https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/digital-agency/

A digital agency that gets you booked.
Aussie Growth is an Australian digital agency for tradies, home-service and local businesses. One team builds your website, runs your ads and automates your follow-up.


### One team. Three jobs.

A digital agency looks after the online side of a business. For most small businesses that means three things: a website people trust, ads that put you in front of people who are looking, and a system that follows up every enquiry.

Aussie Growth does all three. You deal with one team, not three agencies passing the blame around.

- Web development: Custom websites, landing pages and quote forms. Mobile-first, and built to make the next step obvious.
- Paid ads: Google, Meta and Instagram ads that reach people already looking, with tracking so you can see what works.
- AI and automations: CRM, instant replies, follow-up and booking automation, so good leads do not go cold.

### From first message to live.

1. Tell us what is going on: Fill in the five-question quote form. It takes about a minute.
2. Get a clear recommendation: A real person replies with what we would do first, and a quote. No 40-slide deck.
3. We build and launch: A website, ads, automation, or a mix. You review it before it goes live.
4. We measure what happens: We track enquiries, calls and bookings, and tell you what we see. No made-up numbers.

### Built for people who actually do stuff.

We work best with tradies and home-service businesses (builders, electricians, plumbers, landscapers, roofers, solar, HVAC and renovators) and with local businesses such as clinics, gyms, hospitality, automotive, retail and professional services. If you answer your own phone, you are our people.


### What is the difference?

The names overlap. A digital marketing agency usually focuses on promotion: ads, social media and content. A digital agency also builds the thing people land on: the website, the forms and the booking flow.

We do both sides on purpose. Ads are wasted if the website does not turn clicks into calls, and a good website does little if nobody finds it.


### Questions and answers

Q: What does a digital agency do?
A: A digital agency builds and runs the online side of a business. At Aussie Growth that means websites, paid ads on Google, Meta and Instagram, and AI and automation such as CRM, instant replies and follow-up.

Q: Is Aussie Growth a digital marketing agency?
A: Yes, and a bit more. We run paid ads and automation, and we also build the websites those ads send people to. Everything sits under one team.

Q: Who does Aussie Growth work with?
A: Australian tradies, home-service businesses and local businesses. If you answer your own phone, you are who we build for.

Q: How much does a digital agency cost?
A: It depends on what you need. Tell us what you are trying to achieve and we give you a clear quote. Two Australian businesses also get a professional website for $0 every Monday, with a short video testimonial as the one catch.

Q: Do I need a long contract?
A: No. We would rather keep you because it is working than because a contract says so. We are upfront about terms before anything starts.

Q: Can I get just a website, or just ads?
A: Yes. Most people start with one thing. The three services work best together, but you can use them separately.


## Google Ads Management for Tradies & Local Businesses | Aussie Growth
URL: https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/google-ads/

Google Ads that ring the phone.
When someone searches for what you do, you want to be the business they call. We set up and run Google Ads that put you in front of people already looking.


### Be there when they search.

Google Ads shows your business to people at the moment they search, for example "plumber near me" or "roof repairs". People who search are usually ready to act.

That is why Google Ads suits tradies, home-service businesses and local operators who need the phone to ring.


### Setup, running and tracking.


What we set up:
- Campaign strategy and structure
- Keywords and area targeting
- Ad copy that sounds like you
- Conversion tracking for calls and form enquiries
- A landing page that matches the ad
- Ongoing optimisation

What you get back:
- Reporting in plain English
- Enquiries, calls and bookings tracked, not just clicks
- A realistic starting budget
- No long contract
- A real person to talk to

### Clicks are easy. Calls are the point.

A click costs money whether or not the visitor calls. So we send ad traffic to a page built to turn visitors into enquiries: a clear service, a clear next step, and a call button or quote form that works on a phone.

If you do not have that page yet, we build it.


### No guaranteed sales. No made-up numbers.

Nobody can honestly promise a set number of leads. We measure what happens, tell you what we see, and adjust. We would rather spend less and get more jobs than burn budget on vanity clicks.


### Questions and answers

Q: What is Google Ads management?
A: It is the setup and ongoing running of your Google ads: choosing what to target, writing the ads, tracking results and improving the campaign over time.

Q: Do you guarantee leads or sales?
A: No, and be careful with anyone who does. We track enquiries, calls and bookings, tell you what we see, and keep improving the campaign.

Q: How much should I spend on ads?
A: It depends on your industry, your area and how many jobs you can take on. We give you a realistic starting budget, not a made-up number designed to sound impressive.

Q: Do I need a website first?
A: You need a page that turns clicks into calls. If your site does not do that, we can build one, including a $0 website for two Australian businesses every Monday.

Q: Can you run Google Ads and Facebook ads together?
A: Yes. Google catches people who are searching now. Meta ads reach people before they search. Many businesses use both.

Q: Do I need a long contract?
A: No. We would rather keep you because it is working than because a contract says so. We are upfront about terms before anything starts.


## Facebook & Instagram Ads Management | Meta Ads | Aussie Growth
URL: https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/meta-ads/

Get known locally. Get the enquiry.
Meta ads put your business in front of local people on Facebook and Instagram, before they even start searching.


### Reach people before they search.

Meta runs Facebook and Instagram ads. People are not looking for you yet, so the ads work by getting your business in front of the right local people at the right time.

That makes Meta good for getting known in your area, and for jobs people plan ahead, like renovations and fit-outs.


### Setup, running and tracking.


What we set up:
- Campaign strategy and setup
- Audience targeting by location and interest
- Ad copy and layout for Facebook and Instagram
- Conversion tracking
- A landing page or quote form behind the ad
- Ongoing optimisation

What you get back:
- Reporting in plain English
- Enquiries and bookings tracked, not just likes
- A realistic starting budget
- No long contract
- A real person to talk to

### Which one do you need?

Google Ads reaches people who are searching right now and ready to call. Meta ads reach people who are scrolling, which builds awareness and suits planned jobs.

Many businesses get the best result using both, with the same landing page behind them. If you are not sure, tell us what you do and we will say what we would try first.


### Questions and answers

Q: What are Meta ads?
A: Meta ads are paid ads on Facebook and Instagram, run through the Meta advertising platform.

Q: Do you run Instagram ads as well as Facebook ads?
A: Yes. We run Facebook and Instagram ads together or separately, depending on where your customers are.

Q: Are Meta ads good for tradies?
A: They can be, especially for planned work like renovations and fit-outs, and for getting known in your local area. For urgent jobs, Google Ads usually does more of the work.

Q: Do you guarantee leads or sales?
A: No, and be careful with anyone who does. We track enquiries, calls and bookings, tell you what we see, and keep improving the campaign.

Q: How much should I spend on ads?
A: It depends on your industry, your area and how many jobs you can take on. We give you a realistic starting budget, not a made-up number designed to sound impressive.

Q: Do I need a long contract?
A: No. We would rather keep you because it is working than because a contract says so. We are upfront about terms before anything starts.


## AI & Business Automation for Small Business | Aussie Growth
URL: https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/ai-automation/

Let software deal with the repetitive stuff.
Practical AI and automation for tradies and local businesses: instant replies, follow-ups, bookings and CRM, so good leads do not go cold while you are on the job.


### Leads go cold fast.

You are on a roof or behind the counter. An enquiry comes in. By the time you reply, the customer may have already called someone else.

Automation handles the first reply, the follow-up and the booking, so you do not have to do it by hand.


### Front of house. Behind the scenes.


Front of house:
- AI website assistants and chat
- Lead capture and qualification
- Instant automatic replies
- Booking automation and reminders

Behind the scenes:
- CRM setup
- Follow-up by email and SMS
- Workflow automation
- Connecting your business tools

### From enquiry to booking.

1. New enquiry: A customer sends a form or message.
2. Captured: The details land in one place, not in five inboxes.
3. CRM updated: The lead is logged so nothing gets lost.
4. Instant response: The customer gets a reply straight away.
5. Follow-up: Email and SMS follow-ups go out until they answer.
6. Booking: They pick a time, and you get the booking.
Illustrative workflow. Exactly what gets automated depends on your business.

### Is it worth it for you?

Sometimes yes, sometimes no. We tell you honestly if automation is worth it for your setup. No robots, no gimmicks, and only what actually saves you time.


### Questions and answers

Q: What can a small business automate?
A: Common examples are instant replies to new enquiries, follow-up emails and SMS, booking confirmations and reminders, and CRM updates. Exactly what we automate depends on your business.

Q: What is a CRM?
A: A CRM is a system that keeps track of your customers and enquiries in one place, so nothing gets lost. We set it up and connect it to your website and follow-up.

Q: Do I need to be technical?
A: No. We set it up, explain it in plain English and show you what you control.

Q: Will automation make me sound like a robot?
A: Not if it is done properly. We write replies that sound like you, and a real person stays in charge of the conversations that matter.

Q: Can you automate my existing business?
A: Often, yes. The repetitive stuff that eats your evenings is usually a good place to start. We tell you honestly if it is worth it.

Q: Do I need a long contract?
A: No. We would rather keep you because it is working than because a contract says so. We are upfront about terms before anything starts.


## Websites for Tradies in Australia | Aussie Growth
URL: https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/tradie-websites/

Websites for tradies that work the phones.
You are on the tools all day. Your website should be on the phones. We build websites, run ads and automate follow-up for Australian tradies and home-service businesses.


### Your site should look credible.

Most people check a tradie online before they call. If the website is slow, old or hard to use on a phone, they move on.

We build fast, mobile-first sites with a clear service list and a quote button that never wanders off.


### Every trade is different.

- Builders: Show real projects, explain your services clearly and make the quote request easy.
- Electricians: Make your services and service area clear, and put the call button where a thumb can reach it.
- Plumbers: Fast on mobile, clear about what you cover, with an obvious way to call or book.
- Landscapers: Let your work speak with project photos, and keep quote requests simple.
- Roofers: Show your work and your service area, with an easy way to ask for a quote.
- Solar: Explain the offer simply and turn "just looking" into a quote request.
- HVAC: Make it easy to book a visit or ask for a quote.
- Renovations: Showcase projects and ask the right questions in a short quote form.

### Real sites we built.

Silk Building Group is a premium site for a Canberra builder: big imagery, clear services and a quote button that never wanders off. Capital Solar Energy is a home-services site built to turn "just looking" into "can you come out Thursday?".


### $0 website. Yes, really.

Two Australian businesses get a professional website for $0 every Monday. We design it, we build it, and you pick the Monday we start. It is live in about a month, with 3 revisions.

The catch is a short video testimonial once your site is finished and you have seen it. A $1,500 fast-track gets it live in about a week.


### Questions and answers

Q: Do you build websites for tradies?
A: Yes. Builders, electricians, plumbers, landscapers, roofers, solar, HVAC and renovators are who we build for.

Q: How much does a tradie website cost?
A: It depends on what you need. Tell us what you want to achieve and we give you a clear quote. Two Australian businesses also get a website for $0 every Monday.

Q: How long does a website take?
A: Most small business sites take a few weeks, and bigger builds take longer. The biggest variable is usually content: photos, copy and sign-off. The $0 website goes live in about a month, and the $1,500 fast-track in about a week.

Q: Can you help people find my tradie business on Google?
A: We run Google Ads that put you in front of people searching for your trade, and we build the site those ads send people to.

Q: Can the website take quote requests?
A: Yes. We build quote forms and booking requests into the site, so enquiries come straight to you.


## Websites, Ads & Automation for Local Businesses | Aussie Growth
URL: https://www.aussiegrowth.agency/local-business-marketing/

Be the best in the suburb. Make sure it knows.
Being the best in the suburb only counts if the suburb knows. We help Australian local businesses get found, get booked and stop chasing admin.


### Found locally. Booked easily.

Local customers search on their phone, compare a few options and choose the one that looks credible and is easy to contact.

We build the website, run the ads and set up the follow-up, so that business comes to you.


### Local businesses we work with.

- Clinics: Make services and booking requests clear, and follow up enquiries quickly.
- Gyms: Turn website visits into trial and membership enquiries.
- Hospitality: Make bookings and enquiries easy, and keep the personality of the venue.
- Automotive: Make it easy to request a quote or book a service.
- Retail: Show what you sell and give people a reason to visit or enquire.
- Professional services: Look credible, explain what you do in plain language and make the first conversation easy.

### Sites and systems we built.

Mazzia Resorts is a slow, cinematic site for a resort brand. Harborview is a hotel-and-cafe operations prototype that handles bookings, housekeeping, orders and follow-ups in one place. Hartwell Media is a loud, playful agency site with personality in every scroll.


### The short checklist.


On the site:
- What you do, in plain language
- Where you are and who you serve
- Real photos and real projects
- A call button and a quote or booking form
- Fast and easy on a phone

Behind the site:
- Ads that reach people in your area
- Tracking for calls and enquiries
- Instant replies to new enquiries
- Follow-up so leads do not go cold

### Questions and answers

Q: What kinds of local businesses do you work with?
A: Clinics, gyms, hospitality, automotive, retail and professional services, as well as tradies and home-service businesses.

Q: What should a local business website include?
A: A clear description of what you do, where you are, real photos or projects, a call button, a quote or booking form, and a site that loads fast and works well on a phone.

Q: Do you run ads for local businesses?
A: Yes. We run Google, Meta and Instagram ads aimed at people in your area, and we track the enquiries they bring in.

Q: Can you set up automatic replies and bookings?
A: Yes. We set up instant replies, follow-up by email and SMS, and booking automation, so new enquiries get an answer straight away.

Q: Do I need a long contract?
A: No. We would rather keep you because it is working than because a contract says so. We are upfront about terms before anything starts.
